name: How do I choose a reputable contractor for window replacement in an older home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reputable contractor for window replacement in an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for contractors with specific experience in older homes, as they understand the unique challenges like varied wall thicknesses, potential lead paint, or asbestos. Check for proper licensing, insurance, and positive reviews or testimonials. Request references and ask to see examples of their previous work on similar projects. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed, written estimate, a clear timeline, and a warranty for both materials and labor. Don't hesitate to ask about their specific approach to older home projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in older homes, verify their license and insurance, check references, and ensure they provide a detailed estimate and warranty.
